bear_assumptions: USD 2.50 forward EPS at 36x as growth normalizes, customer concentration or deployment delays surface, and manufacturing, service, fuel or policy costs constrain margins; diluted shares and warrants remain explicit.
base_assumptions: USD 4.50 forward EPS at 40x as contracted AI deployments support growth but margins normalize and dilution, capacity execution, fuel economics and competition keep the multiple below peak expectations.
bull_assumptions: USD 6.00 forward EPS at 50x as Oracle deployment, broader hyperscaler adoption and capacity expansion deliver exceptional profitable growth with controlled service, fuel, financing and dilution costs.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only if price or fresh primary evidence restores positive base and confidence-adjusted expected return, favorable bear/base and expected/bear payoff, margin of safety, minimum confidence and an accepted relationship; downgrade further if deployments, customer breadth, margin, cash conversion, capacity, service, fuel, regulation, supply, financing or dilution deteriorate.
